outcome.technical: MATRIX (tools/check-report-interactive.mjs): ONE layout matrix replaces nw1, ph1 (shut, sideways and open stacks) and ph2. Sizes are 390x844, 844x390, 834x1194, 1024x768 and 1512x945. States are read off the page: every View option at rest, then the default view with one phase-status chip on, and with a search typed (the first drawn phase's id). That is 25 cells per fixture, each reported by name as `lmN <w>x<h> <state>`. Per cell: lm1, the hit-test stack over the table is within its layer-derived bound (the top bar, strip and filter bar layers whose computed position is sticky AND that span the scan column, so the desktop sidebar strip is not counted, + STACK_SLACK_PX). lm2, within the ceiling (STACK_CEILING_SHARE of the height). lm3, the count is one line, read from its drawn text nodes' client rects (text clipped to 1px skipped), not by emptying the text. lm4, the filter bar's flex lines are no more than its controls need packed end to end at their natural widths (flex-basis length, else drawn width; the count by its unbroken text). lm5, while the top bar pins, the header filter row is one line. lm6, More filters opened over the table lies within the viewport and is painted top and bottom. lm7, where the open panel is in the bar's flow, the bar does not pin and the stack is within the remaining layers. A spacer row two screens tall is appended to the phases tbody for the matrix's length only, so a narrowed table is still long enough to sit under the chrome; it is removed afterwards. The phone step keeps only what is the phone's own: the open panel's controls on screen, and the two layout-baseline figures. FEATURE_ABSENT 'phone panel check skipped' now covers lm6/lm7. R23: the ceiling label prints STACK_TABLE_SHARE = +(1 - share).toFixed(2). New vh1 (at rest): the count's live text names the view's short name, and the DRAWN text is only 'N of M phases'. A committed fixture with a pinned phase is owed if that dependence is unwanted. R18: filters.js keeps the view name in the live region inside a span with class vh (a clipped box), so the drawn count is 'N of M phases' plus the task fraction when filtered. controls.css: #audit-count{flex:0 0 auto;white-space:nowrap} and a .vh rule (the same rule as the panel's base-controls.css, noted as a pair). R19: shell.css @media (52rem < width <= 64rem) stacks each scope under its label, wraps the trailing '(phases & usage)' and caps the header selects at 9rem. At 834x1194 the top bar went 160px -> 122px (acme) and 145px -> 122px (demo). R20: es0 records `fewer` (rows below resting) apart from `narrowed`; the search and search+chip kinds count only `fewer`. R21: the clause reads ', N cancelled not counted'. The gate's two regexes and labels follow it. R22: _report_page.py:509 says 'sticky; on a narrow or a short screen the bar scrolls with the page'; st4's label says 'on a narrow or a short screen'; forced-colors.css and test comments name lm1 instead of ph1. FOUND BY THE MATRIX AND FIXED: at 1024x768 in View=archived the open More filters panel spanned x=-26..486 at HEAD (acme, demo; live -31), because it hung from its own control's right edge and the control had wrapped to the left. .fdetails is no longer positioned, so the panel hangs from the sticky .sectools. Pins updated deliberately: c5 (panel pin: .fdetails not positioned), st3, st4 ('lm1' in the stylesheet), c5b (new count construct: the vh span, appended once, .vh rule present), c5d (wording, and 'cancelled match' absent). NOT MET, stated plainly: R18 asked for a single-line BAR at 1512 at rest, filtered and in every view. The count is now one line everywhere, but at 1512x945 the bar is 2 flex lines (92px against 60px at rest) once anything filters, on all three fixtures, and on the live render in View=all. Measured filtered at 1512: the bar's inner width is 1166px; its controls need 1193px (acme), 1298px (demo) and 1534px (live: Sort select, and a 391px count with the cancelled clause). Every one of them fits on one line WITHOUT the count. So the count still costs the pinned bar a line there; at 1024 rest on acme it does too. At HEAD the same acme filtered state was a 74px bar with the count squeezed onto 3 text lines; it is now a 92px bar with a one-line count. Hiding the view name cannot close that. The structural options are a UI design call: take the count out of the pinned bar's flow, or move expand/Clear out of it. The gate does not pass this silently: lm4's comment states it as a known open cost, and lm4 prints the lines and the need per cell. Recommend filing it as a finding.
